Retrieved 2026-10-13 from https://catalogo.facet.eu/EN using PoliteSession
with at least 5 seconds between network requests to the source host.
Metadata JSON is the actual anonymous DettaglioFinale response. References
retain all visible grouped rows for 9.6027, 9.6070 and 9.3001. Applications
retain the first four Audi rows for 9.6027, and all three MG / MG (SAIC)
rows for 9.3001. Search retains actual own-code cards for Audi 811905115.
Harvest retains the source's MG maker links, MG (SAIC) 550 model row,
returned public engine-group ID, numeric vehicle IDs and three product IDs.
HTML is reduced with BeautifulSoup; presentation/scripts/other makes are
omitted where stated. The bootstrap fixture is a synthetic minimal wrapper
with actual control names and a fake, non-sensitive callback state. Tests
construct callback wrappers around the real HTML excerpts; no live server
signature or packed binary state is committed or deserialized. Runtime
PoliteSession records unmodified complete responses, including form bodies.
Raw probe cache is outside apps/parsers/.cache. Only catalogue read actions
were called: no PDF-by-email, captcha, marketing, history or account action.
